parent_work.budget_comparability: 2000 derivative-free functionevaluations are not120 Adamsteps. Parentprotocol cost is separatelyreported; do not claim equal computation or isolate capacity/optimizer effects.

architecture.encoder: Exact bitwise parent W,b, sigmoid27to8; freeze throughout new search. No new scaler or encoder fitting.
architecture.score_gauge: Subtract the full SOXX expert row of A,a,K from every expert row, setting its score identically0; sparsemax is translation invariant.
architecture.holdings_gauge: After score gauge, use hS=1-hL-hC: a_new=a+K_S, K_L_new=K_L-K_S, K_C_new=K_C-K_S, K_S_new=0. This preserves every valid-simplex target.
architecture.coordinate_order: Row-major expert rows[SOXL,CASH,HOLD], each [hidden0..7,bias,holding_SOXL,holding_CASH]. 3*(8+1+2)=33 finite float64 searchcoordinates, no parameterbounds/projection.
architecture.identifiability_scope: Common-score and bias/holdings-simplex redundancy removed; do not claim statistical identifiability. Constant control and particular data may have additional feature/score redundancy.
architecture.parent_embedding: For parent alpha_L,alpha_C,alpha_H, copy their affine hidden rows; set alpha_S=1-sum(other3), K0; then apply both algebraic gauges. No fit or approximate imitation.
architecture.activation: Existing exact sparsemax forward, strict positive support; no softmax, epsilon, temperature or straight-through derivative. New search takes no model gradient.
architecture.exact_hold: Strict sole-H support copies actualh exactly and creates no order; no near-H band or order threshold.
architecture.exact_null: Retain the existing canonical zero_anchor() object with A=K0,a=[0,1,0,0] as independentreference/returnednull, preservingitsstructuralpredicate andfinite-inputencoderbypass. The equivalent searchhead hasallslopes0 andnon-SOXXbiases-1; onlysearchcoordinatesmustbe gaugefixed. A nullparent searchx0 mayuse thatgauge, butnullincumbentties returncanonicalzero_anchor. Null is not an extraoptimizerstart.
architecture.input_state: The same currentowned3asset weights for every component at eachdecision. No benchmark/teacher/private-component holdings.
architecture.algebraic_revision_before_registration: Draft36 coefficients reduced to33 by eliminating three bias/holding-simplex null directions before any implementation, test fit or market result. The function class on validholdings is unchanged; no outcome-selected dimension grid.

search.initial_search_point: The one verified embedded parent. No freshrandom/restarted/null optimizerstarts; null is evaluated separately only as an incumbent/reference.
search.objective: Minimize -F, where A_c=63*mean(log(g_policy,c)-log(g_SOXX,c)) and F=min(A_10,A_25). No smoothedminimum, planning horizon, turnoverpenalty or legacyJ veto.
search.constraints: Four COBYLA inequality values equal -g_k, where g_k=(policypositive_loss-benchmarkpositive_loss)/benchmarkpositive_loss, ordered10DD,10CVaR,25DD,25CVaR. Ideal search constraints are g<=0; optimizercatol0. Retained feasibility is independently evaluated with the unchanged raw1e-10pp numericaltolerance, never from catol or solverstatus.
search.budget_accounting: The initialparent head is uniqueevaluation1, including its two-cost fullpath calculation, and is reused by exact-byte cache callbacks. Static benchmark/reference construction and independent parity verification are identified separately, not searchtrials. Cap uniquehead fullpath evaluations at2000 even if callback ordering would exceedSciPy nfev. Log requestedcallbacks, cachehits, uniqueevaluations, solvernfev, termination and budget-stop cause separately.
search.cache_key: Exact canonical little-endian float64 row-major33-vector bytes plus fixedinput/cost/modelidentity. No decimal rounding, near-equality cache, smoothing or parameterclipping. Objective and constraint callbacks share one evaluatedmetrics record.
search.cache_storage: Keep scalar/risk/actiondiagnostics and all33coordinates for eachuniqueevaluated head. Keep fullpaths only for current/best incumbents plus parent/reference verification; do not retain a dailyarray for everytrial. A final verification replay is labeledverification, not another searchcandidate.
search.nonfinite_trial: Nonfinite score/head/risk/path or invalidsimplex/funding is an explicit numericalfailure. No replacementpenalty, clippedparameter or silentretry. Stop and retain valid accountingincumbent whiledisqualifying the fit/campaign.
search.termination: Budget/convergence/solverfailureflags are recorded. Maximum-evaluation termination is not automatically scientificfailure; a verified feasible incumbent remainsvalid. Solver success is neither a feasibilitycertificate nor a globaloptimalityclaim. Unexpectedsolverexception/nonfinite is numericalfailure, not noedge.
no_result_driven_changes: No changed economic or source gate

settlement.forward: Four sign roots n=(1+c*s.h_r)/(1+c*s.z_r), choose minimum exact funding residual. n+c*sum(abs(n*z_r-h_r))=1; report actual turnover/fees. Opening values n*z; endingh=z*(1+r)/(z dot(1+r)); state is cost-independent.
settlement.backward: Implicit differentiation of exact funding equation: s=sign(actual riskytrade), exactzeros0; D=1+c*s dot z_r; dn/dz_r=-c*n*s/D; dn/dh_r=c*s/D. Thirdassetpartials0. No costinputgradient. No epsilon bands, fee smoothing or straight-through replacement.
settlement.kink_scope: This is a fixed generalized-gradient selection, not a unique ordinary derivative or a specified buy/sell one-sided derivative. Smooth-region finite differences, coupledHOLD, state identity and implicit-chain consistency must pass before anymarketfit.
settlement.selection_argument: For free ambient risky h,z with positive denominators, fractional sign implicit gradients are denominator-reweighted convex combinations of adjacent sign-region gradients. At simplex boundaries this is an ambient generalized-gradient convention; do not equate it with all feasible one-sided directional derivatives.
settlement.numerical_contract: Fail closed on invalid simplex/returns/finite values or funding residual>1e-12. No rowdropping/root clipping or nearzero trade override. StrictsoleH targetequalsactualh exactly. Forward independent NumPy/accounting and initialparentpath parity required.

normalized_cost_state_scope: Post-fee normalized targets are cost-blind; fee funding changes NAV/trade amounts, not necessarily normalized holdings.

limitations: Historical years have been reviewed; no fresh forward evidence or guaranteed future excess.
Sparse actions and path risks are nonsmooth; finite derivative-free search has no global optimality guarantee.
New search uses finite COBYLA function evaluations, not gradients or TBPTT. The inherited parent was trained with its original approximate derivative/truncation conventions.
Retained training models satisfy historical mean-excess and tail constraints; this does not guarantee future wealth/risk or optimizer convergence.
Source basis retains published-versus-server adjustment differences and16secondary observations.
Historical open prices and continuous adjusted shares are not evidence of actual spread, impact or partial fills.
